description: Defines the QuicBackendResponse class, which models HTTP response headers and body, including response types, delay simulation, and associated data structures for use in QUIC protocol testing and server backend responses.

classes.name: quic::QuicBackendResponse
classes.description: Represents an HTTP response with headers, body, response type, and delay, used in QUIC server backend responses.

classes.name: quic::QuicBackendResponse::ServerPushInfo
classes.description: Stores information for server push responses, including URL, headers, priority, and body.

methods.name: early_hints()
methods.description: Returns the list of early hint headers.

methods.name: body()
methods.description: Returns the response body as a string view.

methods.name: AddEarlyHints()
methods.description: Adds an early hint header with status 103.

methods.name: set_delay()
methods.description: Sets a delay before sending the response, for testing.
